title: 60-day dispensing of PBS medicines
summary: Prescribers may order two months' supply of eligible PBS medicines, phased in by medicine on 1 September 2023, 1 March 2024 and 1 September 2024.
direction_rationale: Fewer dispensing events cut pharmacy revenue; with entry still limited by location rules, the effect on pharmacy numbers and services is unclear.

assessment.summary: Prescribers may order two months' supply of eligible medicines. Patients make fewer pharmacy visits and pay one co-payment for two months; pharmacies dispense less often.

marks.reason: Halves the dispensing fees and co-payments paid per month of medicine, removing a cost that bought no extra service.
